text_block_list.text:
Peeking into the dance studio,
I saw Seeking the Pearl and El Condor Pasa
practicing dance together.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
One-two, one-two!
And turn here!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¿Qué!? Was that really the next dance move?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
No problem with the details!
Now, let's follow the passion, and El spins too!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, turn!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Step as your heart desires! And visualize!
Our blazing passion will spread its wings
and soar through the vast sky!!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: —Ha!? Wh-What is this...!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Come on, El, picture it!
We're wearing hot costumes!
Before our eyes are endless grasslands! The open sky!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We'll send our passion
all the way beyond that horizon!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes I AM!!
Dancing with passion!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's it, keep it up!
Focus solely on expressing the emotions welling up in your heart!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: We can soar—limitlessly!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Yes! El is also going to spread her wings... with all her might, desu!!

...It is wonderful to see them dancing with such joy,
but they appear to have derailed quite significantly
from the official choreography.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Bravo, El!
Thanks for the passionate dance!
choice_data_list: Still, that's pretty far from the original choreography...
Still, that's pretty far from the original choreography...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that may indeed be true.
However, a concert is a stage for delivering our passion to the fans!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Express your emotions just as your heart desires!
Nothing is more important than that!!
choice_data_list: The thrill born from synchronized dancing is pure passion too!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Let's keep this momentum going
and polish our emotional expression!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Right on it, Senpai!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Mmm~... Indeed, disrupting harmony is hardly my intention.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Then how about showing off some freestyle dance during the interlude?
Interludes can be freestyle sometimes, can't they?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"That's where we'll express
our passion to the absolute fullest!!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! That's a fantastic idea!
I'll follow you to the ends of the earth, Senpai!

And so, the two of them completed
a choreography full of passion.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, you have a point.
Someone must have poured their passion into
crafting this song as a group performance..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Then it's our job to take that passion and elevate it to new heights...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, well said, Trainer!
Let's practice the proper choreography again from the top!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"...So, what was the choreography
after that step earlier?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"...Pearl-senpai, did you forget the choreography
and start dancing something completely different, by any chance?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Heheh, don't worry about the small details, El!

Afterward, Seeking the Pearl learned choreography
from El Condor Pasa and completely mastered the dance for the live show.
